comment.body:
Thanks for reporting that Keyboard Manager did not work in browsers. The current description does not make clear whether `Ctrl+C` was mapped to `1` or `1` was mapped to `Ctrl+C`, and it does not include the type error.

Please provide the following.
1. One exact source-to-target remap and any app scope.
2. The browser name/version and whether the same remap works in Notepad.
3. The exact error text or screenshot.
4. After reproducing on the current stable PowerToys release, comment `/bugreport` immediately so the saved mapping and Keyboard Manager logs are captured.
